description: Loads a Plot Speaks story or game, of any kind (mystery, choose-your-path, trivia, dice or word game, Team Trivia, campaign), by slug or title. Returns its script as text (setting, cast, scenes or board, and how it is narrated; one chapter at a time for multi-chapter stories) and a play id the play's other tools take. Records an anonymous play (story, connecting assistant, time; no conversation text), and on the account connector adds it to the player's history. An unknown slug or title returns an error naming close matches or the available stories; a chapter past the last returns an error; an unreleased chapter returns its release date.

chapter.description: Chapter number for a multi-chapter story, e.g. 2 for the second chapter (default 1); an error if the story has fewer chapters

minutes.description: For a trivia game: minutes the player has, e.g. 25, so the game is sized to fit

new_campaign.description: For a campaign, when a signed-in player already has one: true starts a fresh campaign instead of carrying on their latest (default false)

path_code.description: For a choose-your-path story: the three-word path code a friend received at an ending, e.g. brave-river-stone, to follow that friend's choices; codes last 30 days, an unknown one returns an error

play_id.description: With chapter above 1: the play id returned for chapter 1, e.g. 3f2b8c1e-9d4a-4e7b-a1c2-5b6d7e8f9a0b, so both chapters count as one play; ignored if it belongs to another story

resume_code.description: For a campaign: the three-word code given at the end of an earlier session, e.g. amber-otter-lantern; carries on that campaign's world instead of starting one. An unknown code returns an error

slug.description: The story's slug or title, matched loosely, 2 to 80 characters, e.g. example-dinner-party or The Last Toast

team.description: For the team-trivia story: the team as the player said it, e.g. Steelers, Pittsburgh or PIT; "Yankees vs Red Sox" gives a rivalry board. Several matches or an unsupported team return a message instead of a board

versus_code.description: For a trivia board: the three-word code a friend received at the end of their game, to play the same board and compare scores; pass slug "versus" with it, the code names the game. Codes last 30 days

name: start_story
title: Start a story
